objective: Implement the framework-neutral Stage 3 execution-ablation capability specified by the approved Theme Chokepoint PRD v1.0: WP0-WP4 only (contracts/planner, durable candidate ledger and migrations, sequential and bounded isolated executors, blind counter worker, and paired evaluation). Preserve the current single-mode production behavior and all existing Stage 3 scoring, source-policy, validation, canonical-write, and RunStatus semantics. Do not implement Stage 4 independent verification, framework selection/adapters, deployment, provider expansion, automatic promotion, trading, or external publication.
acceptance_checks: PRD-TC-EXEC-001 through PRD-TC-EXEC-008 are implemented for Stage 3 only; unknown modes fail closed and production remains single by default.
Evidence task keys are canonical and mode-independent; task IDs are execution-scoped; strict-replay paired plans align by complete ordered task-key set.
Isolated execution has server-bounded concurrency, stable merge order, shared budgets, task-level failure containment, lease/fencing, and targeted retry without rerunning unchanged successful tasks.
Blind counter packets reject every forbidden field; isolated critics use distinct worker identities and fresh contexts; packet blindness and context blindness are reported truthfully.
Both execution modes preserve the existing Stage 3 schema, lineage, scoring, source-policy, canonical-write, and RunStatus contracts; candidates remain execution-scoped and cannot auto-promote.

Paired comparison reports validity, identities, task differences, concurrency, cost, latency, context, counter-evidence, validation results, and proof limitations; mismatches fail as PAIR_INVALID without a topology-quality conclusion.
All changed runtime, contract, persistence, retry, and orchestration behavior has recorded TDD RED/GREEN evidence, relevant Stage 3/4 regression coverage, and deterministic verification passes.
